item.title: BRICS condemns unilateral tariffs, coercive measures
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The BRICS countries have voiced serious concern over the rise of unilateral tariffs and non-tariff measures that distort trade and violate World Trade Organization rules, while condemning unilateral coercive measures that violate international law.
item.content:encoded:

Tehran, IRNA – The BRICS countries have voiced serious concern over the rise of unilateral tariffs and non-tariff measures that distort trade and violate World Trade Organization rules, while condemning unilateral coercive measures that violate international law.

item.title: Why Iran seeks permanent end to war, not temporary ceasefire?
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Republic of Iran has emphasized that the key objective in the ongoing war is to eliminate the threat and secure a decisive and permanent end to the war, stressing that a temporary ceasefire without guarantees against renewed aggression would not provide lasting stability.
